name: Mazie Hirono

issue_poll.name: Fox News Voter Analysis, Hawaii, 2024 general election (most important issue facing the country); Pacific Resource Partnership / Anthology Research Hawaii Perspectives, Nov 8 to Dec 14, 2024
issue_poll.note: Ranks 1-9 come from the Fox Hawaii voter survey (n about 643). Rank 10, housing, is the top state concern in the PRP survey (https://alohastatedaily.com/2025/03/05/how-is-hawaii-faring--a-new-survey-asked-more-than-900-residents-responded.), which the Fox list does not include. Cost of living is folded into the economy.

issues.position: Block Republican cuts to safety-net programs; protect Social Security, Medicare
issues.note: H.R.1 cut Medicaid and SNAP; she voted against it.

issues.position: Pass comprehensive immigration reform covering DACA recipients
issues.note: No floor vote on comprehensive immigration reform this term.

issues.position: Fund green-energy research and climate-resilience projects
issues.note: H.R.1 rescinded unspent Inflation Reduction Act clean-energy funds.
No national abortion ban reached a Senate floor vote this term.

votes.question: Cloture on the motion to proceed

issues.position: Protect the right to vote (no specific policy named)
Secure defense-bill funding for Hawaii military infrastructure

votes.bill_title: National Defense Authorization Act for FY2026
votes.question: On passage

votes.bill_title: National Defense Authorization Act for FY2026
votes.question: On the motion to concur in the House amendment

issues.note: The final bill authorized over $1 billion for Hawaii military construction.

issues.position: Limit assault weapons; require a federal gun license
issues.note: No Senate floor vote on these gun measures this term.

issues.position: Fund Native Hawaiian housing programs; oppose ending them
issues.note: H.R.7148 included $22.3 million for the Native Hawaiian Housing Block Grant.

caveats: Her vote against H.R.1 is the only vote behind the economy and climate ratings.
Immigration position comes from a Feb 2024 Senate statement, not campaign material; her 2024 campaign site does not mention immigration.
H.R.1's Planned Parenthood funding cut was not counted for abortion because her stated position was to block a national ban.
Campaign positions come from her campaign site (last modified Oct 2024) and an Oct 2024 Civil Beat Q&A; she skipped the only televised debate.
Roll call 570 vote taken from her office's release (via Maui Now) and CRS; other roll calls confirmed via watch.vote, govinfo or thelobbynews.
